'''Vor Harkass''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] scout during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Harkass was born on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] to a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] dancer, who was owned by a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. After being hiding Harkass away for a few years, the dancer sent her child to live with relatives on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] when Harkass was eight years old. Harkass was enrolled in the [[University of Alderaan/Legends|Aldera University]] and decided to become a scout and explore [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Harkass's relatives were dismayed by Harkass's decision to join the scout corps of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] and tried to persuade Harkass that the Empire and [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] were evil, but Harkass ignored this

Harkass served aboard the [[YT-2400 light freighter/Legends|YT-2400 light freighter]] ''[[Predator's Beak]]''. However, it crash-landed on the planet [[Yorgraxx]] and was left with no functioning engines of communication systems, while Harkass and [[Arran Flekk]] were the only survivors. After they had been there over a month, they encountered the surviving crew of a crashed [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] ship and they joined forces. They soon after entered the [[Fornayh's fortress|fortress]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Quorlac Fornayh]], where they confronted his reawakened spirit.

==Behind the scenes==
Harkass featured in the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]] scenario ''[[Shadows in the Force]]'' and has no canonical gender, as that is established by the player.
